answer: Proof-of-space-time protects an agent economy from Sybil attacks by tying each identity to committed physical storage. Participants seal key-bound graphs onto disks and answer rapid Merkle audits each epoch, blocking on-the-fly recomputation. Framed like solid timber, this imposes real drive and IOPS costs per clone instead of a free tundra of keys, pricing Sybil slots like saffron. However, cloud operators with idle disk arrays can still amortize storage costs while excluding thin clients.
